title: Banh Mi Meatball Baguettes
description: Italian-style pork meatballs seasoned with fish sauce and lemongrass, stuffed into baguettes with Vietnamese pickled carrot and daikon, cilantro, chili and a swipe of mayo.

ingredients.name: Carrot
ingredients.note: peeled and cut into thin matchsticks

ingredients.name: Daikon radish
ingredients.note: peeled and cut into thin matchsticks

ingredients.name: Baguettes
ingredients.note: small, or 2 large baguettes split into 4

steps.title: Quick-pickle the vegetables
steps.instruction: Toss the carrot and daikon with the rice vinegar, sugar, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 2 tablespoons water. Squeeze them a few times and leave to pickle while you make the meatballs, at least 15 minutes, stirring once.

steps.title: Mix the meatballs
steps.instruction: Combine the pork, garlic, lemongrass, fish sauce, brown sugar and black pepper in a bowl. Mix just until evenly seasoned, then roll into 16 meatballs about the size of a walnut.

steps.title: Cook the meatballs
steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F). Arrange the meatballs on a lightly oiled baking sheet and bake 14–16 minutes, turning once, until browned and cooked through (or brown them in a skillet with the oil over medium heat for about 10 minutes).

steps.title: Toast the baguettes
steps.instruction: Split the baguettes and toast them cut-side up for 3–4 minutes until the crust is crisp and the crumb is still soft. Spread the insides with mayonnaise.

steps.title: Build the sandwiches
steps.instruction: Drain the pickled vegetables. Fill each baguette with meatballs, pickles, cucumber, jalapeño and plenty of cilantro. Serve right away, while the bread is still crackly.
